## Checklist

- [ ] The change follows the project's English-only rule (code, comments, docs, commits).
- [ ] Tests were written first and fail without the change; the full suite passes.
- [ ] `dotnet format NetWatcher.slnx --verify-no-changes` is clean.
- [ ] No new warnings; nullable reference types respected.
- [ ] Documentation updated (README / docs) when behavior changed.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or generated build output are included.
